data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Apple Pencil double-tap and squeeze gestures on compatible iPads and iPhones.
data.what_it_does: Detects Apple Pencil double-tap and squeeze gestures via native UIKit interactions and exposes them through Dart callbacks. It supports hover pose information and user preferred action settings on compatible hardware.
use_when: You are building an iOS Flutter app that needs to respond to Apple Pencil double-tap gestures.
You need to handle Apple Pencil Pro squeeze gestures and lifecycle phases.
You want to retrieve the user's preferred Apple Pencil action settings from the iOS Settings app.
avoid_when: You need to implement drawing, handwriting recognition, or raw stylus input tracking.
You are targeting Android, web, or desktop platforms.
You are using Apple Pencil 1st generation or Apple Pencil (USB-C) which do not support these gestures.
strengths: Supports both Apple Pencil double-tap and Apple Pencil Pro squeeze gestures.
Provides hover pose coordinates and z-offset information.
Supports Swift Package Manager alongside CocoaPods.
weaknesses: Limited to iOS and iPadOS platforms only.
Hardware-dependent; older Apple Pencil models lack gesture support entirely.
data.setup_notes: Requires iOS/iPadOS 15.0 or later and compatible Apple Pencil hardware. Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods is supported for iOS integration.
